title: Concrete Ritual
description: A dark, cinematic grime cut built on a sparse half-time DMX kick, leaving wide-open space for a rap. Sawtooth dub-chord stabs step through a minor progression while a sub bass slides underneath; the track peaks early then deconstructs into a delay-soaked breakdown before a stripped outro.
